text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The general assembly of Kuwait Real Estate Company elects new board of directors.

- Acting Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives visiting Lybian trade union officials. Ties between Kuwait and the north African state were badly strained over what Kuwait saw as Lybian sympathy with Iraq during its 1990-91 occupation.
- Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan reiterates Kuwait's rejection to mending ties with former occupier Iraq.
- Cabinet rejects parliament's bid to issue its own weekly publication.
- Kuwait to send urgent humanitarian aid to Iran's quake victims.
- The United States vows defence of Gulf, Kuwait.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index falls 9.3 points to 2275.7.
- Kuwait University teachers to go on strike in pay protest.
